en-US.description: Review Windows driver inventory and available update offers before changing your PC.
en-US.longDescription: Tweaky Driver brings detected devices, installed versions and available driver offers into one review workflow. Check each offer and its source before changing a working PC. Free includes one complete scan of supported sources every 10 days and requires a free account with a verified email; drivers found remain available to download and install until the next scan unlocks. Device inventory and read-only diagnostics remain available between scans. Pro removes scan limits and adds saved jobs and offline kits. Some packages are download-only. Discovery depends on supported sources and compatible packages; a detected offer does not guarantee compatibility or a performance improvement.
en-US.name: Tweaky Driver
en-US.releaseNotes: The title bar and the scheduled scan notice fit small windows, the Indigo Night theme is easier to read, a free scan started offline now says so, and the paused-plan message describes the Free plan correctly.
